_note: Every threshold lives here. Edit, then restart the backend. Points are NIFTY index points.

instruments._vix_note: INDIA VIX in IDX_I. The backend checks Dhan's scrip master on start and overrides this if it differs.

session._trade_windows_note: Indian 'kill zones': after the opening range settles, and the post-lunch institutional window. No new paper entries outside these.
session._expiry_note: Tuesday (Mon=0). Only used as a label - real expiry dates always come from Dhan's expiry list.

data._backfill_note: 1-minute candles fetched on start (one call; Dhan allows 90 days per call). 30 days gives the 1h chart ~200 bars.

alerts._note: Info alerts (BOS, OTE touch) show in the app; only trade setups go to Telegram unless send_info_alerts is true.

paper._lot_note: NIFTY lot = 65 (same as your Paper Desk). Paper P&L is index points x lot_size, a rough proxy for an ITM option. The app never places real orders.
